owner.variable: §9A.7 / M15 — HARNESS tiles ∩ Model rim contact
owner.question: The HARNESS plaques assemble centred (700,300) and overlap the platform Model's lower rim (the segment build's defect 2, carried as Hadi's call). Keep the contact, or clear it?
options: A — Keep the contact (recommended): tiles draw OVER the Model (z decided in the closure), contact measured at Gate 1 and capped at the bolt–Book occlusion precedent (≤ ~1,400 px²). The word visibly crowns the thing it names; the overlap is small, high in frame, and reads as layering, not collision.

B — Clear it: shift the tiles' centre to (700,452), below the Model's rim and above the ring's top — compresses the tiles against the ring and weakens the assemble-on-'harness' sightline to the sweep.
C — Shrink the Model in Scene 2 (w 300 → 260): changes the blessed staging proportion of the Mechanism Stage for one word's sake.
owner.recommendation: A — keep the contact, with the z-order and the Gate-1 cap written into the score (done in R-2, marked conditional on this ruling).
owner.blocks: Blocks the L8 staging sign-off only; every other line is briefable without it.
